tools.name: company_status
tools.description: Free, no API key. Returns dated basic facts for one UK company from official records: status, age, late filings, insolvency notice, and whether a director ban in force is on record. Company-level facts only. Indicators only, not advice. For a risk score and joined register checks, use risk_assess wi

tools.name: check_company_seal
tools.description: Free, no API key. Returns the current signed credential summary for one UK company: record date, confirmed-through date, valid-until time, status facts, and evidence hash. Pass an optional evidenceHash to learn if a credential you hold is CURRENT, SUPERSEDED, or EXPIRED. Returns the URLs to verify t

tools.name: risk_assess
tools.description: Returns a 0 to 100 forensic risk score, risk band, and source-backed governance, premises, licence-gap, solvency, and filing indicators for a UK company. Indicators only, not advice. Each answer states its record date and its source.

tools.name: entity_resolve
tools.description: Returns ranked UK Companies House registration numbers for a fuzzy company name with confidence scores and company status flags. Pass an optional UK postcode to improve match precision. Indicators only, not advice.

tools.name: cross_border_assess
tools.description: Bundled assessment for international enterprise teams checking UK counterparties. Returns source-backed company evidence, uncertainty notes, verification questions, and jurisdiction context. Indicators only, not advice. Each answer states its record date and its source.

tools.name: watch_company
tools.description: Subscribes a registered tenant webhook or email address to alerts when a UK company files an insolvency notice, faces strike-off, or records director disqualifications. Indicators only, not advice.

tools.name: request_corporate_eval
tools.description: Public onboarding tool (no API key required). Emails a 25-call live UK evaluation API key to a corporate work address (not a personal webmail address) and returns a payment link for a paid plan.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: check_company_seal · Private data: company_status, check_company_seal, risk_assess, cross_border_assess, watch_company, request_corporate_eval · Public sink: watch_company · Destructive: request_corporate_eval.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: check_company_seal · Private data: company_status, check_company_seal, risk_assess, cross_border_assess, watch_company, request_corporate_eval · Public sink: watch_company · Destructive: request_corporate_eval

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
